now.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
now.text: Peter unlocks his suit's AI, names her Karen, and she helps him stop the Vulture.
cases: ST-054 The Staten Island Ferry Disaster (Spider-Man: Homecoming)
ST-055 The Coney Island Plane Crash (Spider-Man: Homecoming)

proposed.text: Peter unlocks his suit's AI and names her Karen. She helps him at the Washington Monument and on the Staten Island Ferry, until Tony takes the suit away.

changes.evidence: Karen helps at the Washington Monument and the ferry, but Tony confiscates the Stark suit after the ferry; Peter stops the Vulture in his homemade suit with no Karen (Homecoming plot: 'confiscates Peter's suit', 'dons his old homemade Spider-Man suit').

now.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
now.text: Using the Hand as guards, Damage Control experiments on telepaths, until Spider-Man frees Jean Grey and the department comes under investigation.
cases: ST-135 The Roosevelt Island Incident (Spider-Man: Brand New Day)

proposed.text: Using the Hand as guards, Damage Control experiments on telepaths, until Jean Grey breaks loose at its Roosevelt Island facility. After Spider-Man calms her, the department comes under investigation.

changes.evidence: Spider-Man does not free Jean: she frees herself telekinetically and freezes everyone in a psionic field; Peter infiltrates, defeats the Hand, lets her into his mind and they reconcile; afterward the DODC comes under investigation (Brand New Day plot; Jean Grey page: 'She telekinetically freed herself from restraints').

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 56, Malick brings Hive back to Earth to lead HYDRA.

proposed.text: In episode 54, Malick brings Hive back to Earth to lead HYDRA.

changes.evidence: Hive returns through the portal in Ward's body at the end of 'Maveth' (episode 54, S3E10), where Malick finds him on the road. Episode 56 ('The Inside Man') is Hive regaining strength by sacrificing humans, which the record does not describe.

now.title: Avengers: Endgame
now.text: In 2012, Steve takes it from HYDRA agents inside S.H.I.E.L.D. in a Stark Tower elevator. He returns it once the stones have been used.

proposed.text: In 2012, Steve takes it from HYDRA agents inside S.H.I.E.L.D. in a Stark Tower elevator. He returns the Mind Stone once the stones have been used.

changes.evidence: Steve returns the stones (the Mind Stone) to the alternate 2012, but not the scepter itself; Fandom: 'Rogers returned to the alternate 2012 to return the Mind Stone, albeit without the Scepter.' Wikipedia's Endgame plot says only that he returns the Infinity Stones and Mjolnir.

now.title: Hawkeye
now.text: LARPers retrieve Clint's trick arrows for Kate, who uses them to take down Kingpin.

proposed.text: The LARPers get Clint's trick arrows back from the police. Later, Clint and Kate make a new batch, and Kate uses them to take down Kingpin.

changes.evidence: Wendy Conrad of the LARPers retrieves the arrows from an NYPD facility and hands them to Clint in episode 4; in episode 6 Clint and Kate 'manufacture new trick arrows from scratch', and those are the arrows Kate uses on Kingpin.
